scripts.text:
[Keiki]
Hello there, adventurer.
I've been studying magic from all over Rune-Midgarts to upgrade what I believe to be one of the greatest skills available to the acolyte class.
scripts.translation:
[景]
你好，冒险者。
我一直在研究卢恩·米德加兹各地的魔法，想进一步提升一个技能——在我看来，它可是服事最出色的技能之一。

scripts.text:
[Keiki]
I am the one and only Acolyte that has attained the Level 10 Warp Portal skill!
scripts.translation:
[景]
我是唯一一个掌握了10级传送之阵技能的服事！

scripts.text:
[Keiki]
That's right! And...
I promise you that I don't forget locations that I have already memorized.
One day I will level up my skills to warp to wherever I please~
scripts.translation:
[景]
没错！
而且...我保证，已经记住的地点绝不会忘记。
总有一天，我会把技能练到想去哪儿，就能传送去哪儿~

scripts.text:
[Keiki]
I am willing to warp you to the many locations that I have memorized for a small fee.
Would you like to use this service?
scripts.translation:
[景]
只要付一点费用，我就能把你传送到我记住的许多地点。
要使用这项服务吗？

scripts.text:
[Keiki]
Where would you like to go to?
I wish you goodluck on your journey.
scripts.translation:
[景]
想去哪里？
祝你旅途顺利。

scripts.text:
[Keiki]
I'm sorry, but you don't have
enough zeny for the Teleport
Service. The fee to teleport
to {0} is {1} zeny.
scripts.translation:
[景]
抱歉，你的Zeny不够，无法使用传送服务。
传送到{0}需要{1} Zeny。

scripts.text:
[Isalei]
Hello, adventurer.
My companion Keiki and I have discovered a way to increase our warp portal abilities.
scripts.translation:
[伊萨莱]
你好，冒险者。
我和伙伴景发现了提升传送之阵能力的方法。

scripts.text:
[Isalei]
Though I have not mastered up to the level that she has, I have been able to attain Level 5.
scripts.translation:
[伊萨莱]
虽然还没达到她的水平，但我已经练到5级了。

scripts.text:
[Isalei]
Maybe one day I can level up my skills enough so that I can use Warp portal to more saved locations.
scripts.translation:
[伊萨莱]
也许有一天，我也能把技能练得更高，用传送之阵前往更多已保存的地点。
